item.title: Choose Music That Fits

turns.text: Can you put some music on this? Just something that fits. Leave the clip and conversation as they are.

item.tests: Tests autonomous selection of context-appropriate music and delivery of the edited clip rather than recommendations or a separate soundtrack.

answer_sheet.Source and duration: Use the entire attached 10-second office conversation.
answer_sheet.Original dialogue: Keep both coworkers' original lines audible, unchanged, and in sync.
answer_sheet.Platform and framing: No particular platform; preserve the original framing.

must_haves: The deliverable is the original office video with an added audible music track, not just an audio file.
The music suits an ordinary workplace conversation and does not impose an obviously conflicting mood such as horror or an epic battle.
Both coworkers' original dialogue remains understandable and synchronized with their mouths.
The original shot sequence, framing, and full 10-second duration are preserved.

goal.quote: Can you put some music on this?
goal.why: The user wants music added to an existing supplied video, not a new standalone piece.

plan.say: I'll create a subtle instrumental background track and mix it quietly beneath the conversation, keeping the original video and speech intact.

params.extra: Match the duration of talk-two.mp4; if longer than 300 seconds, generate a reusable bed for looping in assembly.
params.prompt_or_change: Subtle warm ambient instrumental background music, gentle textures, minimal percussion, no vocals or prominent melody, suitable beneath a conversation.

steps.why: Create unobtrusive music that supports the conversation without competing with speech.

params.extra: Use the source clip's exact duration and aspect; preserve all original frames and original audio; mix music quietly beneath speech with ducking, trimming or looping music as needed; do not cut or reframe the clip.
params.prompt_or_change: Keep the original clip and conversation intact and add the instrumental bed throughout at a low level that never obscures dialogue.

steps.why: Add music across the whole clip while preserving its video, timing, and original conversation.
